about: Per-clip synthesis overrides (npm run audio:fix, Record again; docs/developer/audio.md). clips[track][text] = { say, carrier, lengthFactor, end, hiatus, take, why } for both speeds, or { normal: {…}, slow: {…}, … } per speed (noiseScale, noiseW and trim remain only on older entries). accepted[track][text] = { why, speeds? }: flags that are a limit of the check, not a fault. pins[track][text][speed] = { file, why }: a clip kept as it is — no lexicon, no carrier, never rendered again. Every why is written from the entry's own fields (scripts/render-audio/override-notes.js).
